thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC123456 triggered for service="inference-canary" — symptoms: sustained 5xx spike on /v1/generate (us-west-2). metrics: p50=1200ms, p95=3500ms, 5xx=18% (alert threshold=5%). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-degraded

pagerduty: PagerDuty: page fired -> on-call sanjay@redwood (pager level: SEV2).

sanjay: ack — I'm on it. any deploys in the last 30m? paging logs show canary traffic up. :eyes:

devon: I pushed canary 2026-03-14_21:05 UTC (model-serving v2.7.3, kernel opt). I'm in the channel and tailing logs now.

maria: seeing same on console — canary at 10% traffic and sharp error increase. I'm going to divert canary traffic to 0% now to stop impact.

devon: running commands to remove canary: ```bash
rwdctl rollout traffic set inference-service --canary-weight 0
rwdctl rollout status inference-service
```

incident-bot: Action recorded: traffic weights updated -> stable=100%, canary=0%. Noted autoscaler churn and GPU OOM events on node gpu-23. Relevant infra link: https://telemetry.redwood/inference-canary/3245009876

sanjay: confirm the 5xx rate is dropping? I'll hold the page if we see improvement.

lucy: support seeing incoming customer errors — two customers reported session timeouts and partial outputs. I've opened support tickets C-4123 and C-4124 and sent temporary status messages.

devon: 5xx rate falling to ~1.8%, p95 back to ~420ms. However kv-cache miss rate spiked around the canary start time — looks like ABI/serialization mismatch with kernel changes.

maria: proposal: rollback canary image to v2.7.2 (last known good). @kevin can you prepare rollback image and coord deploy?

kevin: on it — preparing stable image gcr.io/redwood/inference:v2.7.2 and will open rollback PR. ETA ~6m. will coordinate with @sanjay for safe rollout.

pagerduty: INC123456 acknowledged by sanjay. Escalation stopped.

devon: logs snippet (truncated):
```
[2026-03-14T21:09:12Z] model-serve ERROR kv_cache: segfault at 0x0 (attempted deref)
[2026-03-14T21:09:12Z] model-serve ERROR request_id=abc123 status=500 runtime=1.2s
...
```

sanjay: lowering severity to monitoring — we've removed canary traffic and are stabilizing. Assigning RCA to devon + maria. Will keep oncall for 30m of quiet.

maria: initiating rollback: ```bash
rwdctl deploy set-image inference-service gcr.io/redwood/inference:v2.7.2 --force
``` Rolling now and watching health checks.

incident-bot: Deploy finished: inference-service -> image gcr.io/redwood/inference:v2.7.2. Health checks: passed. Current metrics: p95=310ms, 5xx=0.9%.

lucy: support update sent to affected customers (C-4123, C-4124). Recorded as "Degraded canary caused transient errors; reverted to stable image; monitoring continues."

sanjay: we'll close the page if metrics remain stable for 15m. Post-incident action: add kv-cache ABI validation to canary precheck and block kernel opt changes without explicit compatibility tests. Postmortem owner: devon.

devon: taking postmortem ownership. I'll capture timeline, root cause (kv cache/kernel incompat), and action items (precheck, unit/interop test, canary-safety gating). Will file under /incidents/postmortems and ping on #eng-postmortems. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
